note: The X autopilot picture allowlist: faceless record art only, black and white, checked by eye one by one on 21 Nov 2026. Banned (a face, a masked face or a figure facing the camera): VexVoid_Jam jam-01, 03, 05, 10, 11, 16, 17, 18. Also left out: jam-07 (a painted face in the wall piece and a figure in the train window), Landscape download-1 (reads as a coin), download-3, -7, -9, -11, -16 (garbled or misspelt letters), download-14 (shows V3X, the token name). twin = a near-identical take: the two count as one picture for the no-repeat rule. Files are fetched from https://www.vexvoid.com/images/<set>/<file> and checked against sha256.
